questions.concept: Agent names attribute replies within a shared thread
questions.context:
Convex 1.41.0 and Agent 0.6.4. The component is mounted. Two Agents named "triage" and "billing" share the same short thread and use default storage. Each uses a deterministic local model that returns "reply". First triage generates with prompt "customer"; then billing generates with prompt "take over", both with `{ threadId }`. The transcript projection is:

```ts
return result.page.slice().reverse().map(doc=>({role:doc.message?.role,author:doc.agentName??null}));
```
questions.question: In oldest-first order, what are the author values for the four stored messages?

options.rationale: Default generation leaves prompt messages without agentName; it identifies generated assistant messages.
Creating or using the billing Agent does not relabel the earlier assistant message.
Prompt messages have no agentName. Each assistant reply preserves the name of the Agent that generated it.
Named Agent generation automatically saves assistant attribution on the component messages.
